name: Parasite Paracide
effect:
If this card is face-up in the Draw Pool and you would draw a card, you must Special Summon 1 「Parasite Paracide」(from the Draw Pool) in Defense Position instead of drawing that card.
①: If this card is Summoned: You lose 2 Life, also all monsters you control become Insect monsters in addition to their original type(s) while you control this card.
②: FLIP: Add this card to the Draw Pool or to the top of the Main Deck.
